hypotheses.decision: One faceted Thing kernel is the canonical base semantic model for materially different authored/runtime Things.
Hierarchy expresses structure/locality and does not implicitly own behaviour, control, authority, persistence or replication.
Groups and leaves share the Thing semantic kernel; group coordination does not require a separate base-object category.
Ordinary authored structure can become a local reusable Definition and then a portable package without changing semantic lineage; physical package/discovery UX is not frozen.
Compatible Behaviour replacement is transactional and preserves Thing/attachment identity with explicit state and pending-work migration; arbitrary compatibility is not promised.
Built-ins, beginner Rules and advanced authoring share one constrained semantic IR boundary; final textual syntax, compiler and VM encoding are implementation choices.
SplashMX owns canonical durable creation semantics above Godot scene/resource serialization.
Durable semantic identity and references are path-independent and survive rename, reparent, lifecycle and loading boundaries.
Principal-attributed explicit capabilities can bound ordinary user-content authority semantically; production process/origin/decoder/crypto isolation still requires physical implementation proof.
Thing meaning can survive dormant/unloaded/rehydrated state without an always-resident process or Godot object.
Logical streaming can be object/subgraph-centric while physical chunks, bundles, packages and cache batches remain implementation policy.
Offline, peer-hosted and dedicated-authoritative execution share one canonical network model primarily through topology/policy changes; transports and deployment are private runtime concerns.
Runtime simulation networking and collaborative document editing are separate consistency systems even if infrastructure is shared.
Godot is replaceable-enough at the durable public semantic boundary, not cost-free to replace as the first rendering/audio/input/physics/runtime substrate.
Versioned generic runtimes loading immutable SplashMX creation data are the ordinary publication path; per-creation builds are exceptional trusted deployments.

The sophisticated semantic model projects into one simple browser create-play-save-publish workflow; novice comprehension, accessibility, localization and final terminology remain product evidence gates.
Canonical authoring can remain locally useful/offline while optional synchronization reconciles later; production collaboration durability, compaction and relay design remain implementation work.

Compatibility is driven by SplashMX schema, IR, required-feature/interface identities and explicit bounded migrations rather than implicit Godot-version equality; indefinite lossless migration of every future semantic change is not promised.

contradiction_audit.resolution: Containment/locality is structural; control, authority, persistence and replication are explicit independent relationships/context.
Node/NodePath/RID/ResourceUID/resource paths are target-private bindings; stable SplashMX IDs are canonical.
Canonical ConnectionId is durable semantic identity; transient transport peer/connection/session handles are runtime context. R-019-01 is frozen.
Runtime state/input/authority/relevance replication and durable collaboration transactions/conflicts are separate consistency planes.
Editable authored, runtime materialization, selected persistent world, collaboration history and transient context are separate planes with explicit transfer rules.
Packaging adds PackageId/revision distribution identity around the existing Definition lineage rather than creating a second object taxonomy.
Human requirements resolve intentionally to an exact immutable lock before runtime, streaming, publishing or offline playback.
Ordinary publication is immutable SplashMX data for a separately built generic runtime; per-creation builds are an exceptional trusted deployment class.
Target decode/transcode/import/cache artifacts are derivatives and cannot replace or field-mix the complete canonical protected AssetId revision.
Logical residency/reference semantics are object/subgraph-centric; physical byte chunks/packages/cache batches remain non-semantic optimization policy.
Integrity/trust/provenance/licensing/source/remix metadata never mints host authority; capabilities are explicit principal-attributed grants.
Capability tokens, peer/session/socket IDs, Godot handles and equivalent live context are excluded from durable authored/save/collaboration records and rebound from current context.
Thing tombstones remove-win over concurrent new endpoints and atomically tombstone incident live connections. R-018-02/R-018-04 are frozen.
Every semantic transaction stages and validates the complete resulting document before publication; convergence alone is insufficient. R-018-03 is frozen.
Definition/instance conflict loci include actual DefinitionId, preventing false conflict across unrelated identically named elements. R-018-01 is frozen.
Acquisition, validation, compatibility, migration and capability checks complete in staging before atomic live publication; failure preserves the old coherent state.
Published creation basis and persistent WorldSave are separate lineages; publishing a new creation revision never silently advances a world basis.
Offline playback requires the exact verified creation/dependency/runtime-compatible closure or typed unavailability; it never silently substitutes a merely compatible revision.
Together projects runtime spawn/control/authority/replication/relevance while People projects edit-plane presence/history/conflicts; neither is a shortcut implementation of the other.
Stage, Timeline, Rules, Components, Together, People, Publish and Inspect are progressively disclosed views over the same Thing/Behaviour/Connection fabric, not alternate canonical models.
Browser local-store/CacheStorage/service-worker/URL keys are replaceable distribution/storage context and cannot substitute for project, creation, package or Asset semantic identity.
Godot RPC/peer/transfer facilities are adapter mechanisms; durable Thing identity, authority epochs, control, replication and relevance are SplashMX-owned semantics.
